name: Scenario Game
description: A structured serious game / simulation exercise in which participants navigate decision trees under uncertainty to explore how different strategic choices lead to divergent futures. Scenario games are used in organisational learning, futures studies, and Cynefin-based sensemaking workshops. They have no fixed dataset; each instance is designed for a specific context.
reputation: Widely used in strategic foresight and management education; not a formal quantitative benchmark.
notes: No canonical version exists; the term refers to a class of participatory simulation exercises. Outcomes are qualitative and context-dependent.
